items.title: Agentic-RAG-Engine
items.subtitle: Enterprise Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation Platform
items.challenge: Standard RAG pipelines suffer from context dilution, hallucination in complex enterprise domains, and poor cross-document synthesis across heterogeneous stores.
items.solution: Multi-agent collaborative architecture with semantic-hybrid routing, sparse BM25 + dense Qdrant vector indexing, and precision reranking for sub-second enterprise queries.
items.architectureFlow: Client Query -> Agent Router -> [Decomposer] -> (Dense Vector + BM25 Sparse) -> Reciprocal Rank Fusion -> Cross-Encoder Reranker -> Local/Remote LLM (vLLM) -> Synthesized Proof Output

items.title: MLOps-Pipeline-Suite
items.subtitle: End-to-End Automated Machine Learning Lifecycle & Monitoring
items.challenge: Experimental ML models frequently fail when transitioning to production due to silent data drift, missing artifact provenance, and unmonitored model degradation.
items.solution: Automated data validation pipeline with statistical drift tracking, DVC dataset versioning, MLflow model registry, and Kubernetes-orchestrated canary deployments.
items.architectureFlow: Data Stream -> Evident Drift Detector -> DVC Snapshot -> Automated PyTorch Retraining -> MLflow Registry Evaluation -> Kubernetes Canary Rollout -> Prometheus/Grafana Telemetry

items.title: Control-AI-Optimizer
items.subtitle: Hybrid Neural Network & Dynamic Control Loop Optimizer
items.challenge: Classical PID/MPC controllers degrade under nonlinear dynamic perturbations, while black-box deep learning models lack deterministic safety guarantees.
items.solution: Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) architecture providing residual error correction on top of classical stability models, evaluated via a high-throughput C#/Python interop.
items.architectureFlow: Sensor Telemetry -> State Observer (Kalman) -> Classical Feedback Loop + [PINN Residual Corrector] -> Lyapunov Stability Guard -> Actuator Signal -> Physical Plant

items.title: Local-AI-Agent-Terminal
items.subtitle: Privacy-Preserving Agentic Developer Workspace
items.challenge: High API latency, compliance and data sovereignty constraints, and lack of contextual syntax comprehension when running agents on private enterprise codebases.
items.solution: Autonomous terminal runtime running 100% offline via local LLM backends (Ollama), powered by Tree-sitter AST parsing, function-level semantic indexing, and an execution sandbox.
items.architectureFlow: Local Shell Prompt -> Tree-sitter Code Parser -> AST Dependency Graph -> Scratchpad Memory Buffer -> Local Ollama Ingestion -> Sandboxed Diff Execution -> Git Commit Verify
